source.title: Clostridioides difficile-induced diarrhoea following dasatinib therapy

semantic_spot_checks.source: CDI was diagnosed during dasatinib therapy without antecedent antibiotic use; authors propose possible association.
semantic_spot_checks.sea: Preserves CDI diagnosis while explicitly limiting causal inference.

semantic_spot_checks.source: 20-25 bowel movements/24 h; dasatinib 140 mg/day; metronidazole 500 mg three times daily.
Single case with no comparator; dasatinib restarted without recurrent diarrhoea for 2 years.
semantic_spot_checks.sea: Appraisal explicitly limits causality and uses non-recurrence after restart as counterevidence.

semantic_spot_checks.source: Figures 1-3 show active ulceration, inflammatory histology, and post-treatment endoscopic resolution.

semantic_spot_checks.sea: Repaired SEA now preserves and flags the negative sign instead of normalizing it.
